reachability.notes: Cloudflare blocks non-browser fetches (403). Playwright succeeds. Site redirects to alphaarcade.com via JS after initial load — XO Market appears to have been acquired/rebranded to Alpha Arcade.

1.1_llms_txt.details: xo.market/llms.txt returns 404. docs.xo.market/llms.txt fails with ECONNREFUSED (subdomain does not exist).

1.2_markdown_negotiation.details: Cloudflare blocks all non-browser requests with 403. No opportunity to test Accept: text/markdown.

1.3_structured_metadata.details: Meta description: 'Open conviction markets for all. Create, trade and share your beliefs with XO Market.' Full OG tags (og:title, og:description, og:image, og:url, og:site_name), Twitter Card (summary_large_image), keywords meta tag, author meta tag, canonical URL.

2.1_content_without_js.details: Next.js SSR app but Cloudflare blocks non-browser fetches (403). Content is only accessible via browser with JS execution. Meta tags are in HTML source but body content requires JS hydration.

2.2_semantic_html.details: Found nav, footer, section (3 semantic tags). Missing main, article, header.

2.5_proper_404s.details: /this-does-not-exist-xyz123 returns '404 This page could not be found.' with correct page behavior.

3.1_dev_docs_exist.details: /docs page exists but only contains placeholder content: FAQ link, 'XO Market Litepaper' (Coming soon), 'XO Oracle Litepaper' (Coming soon). No actual developer or API documentation.

3.2_docs_findable.details: 'Docs' link in top navigation bar, reachable in 1 click from homepage.

3.3_programmatic_surface_documented.details: No REST API documentation, no SDKs (Python, TypeScript, C++), no programmatic surface documented anywhere on the site.

3.4_standard_navigation.details: Standard <a href> links throughout: Home (/), Blog (medium.com/@xomarket), Docs (/docs), Launch App, social links, legal pages. 18 total links on homepage.

4.1_ai_crawlers_allowed.details: No robots.txt (returns 404). No explicit AI crawler policy. Cloudflare blocks non-browser user agents with 403.

4.2_no_captcha.details: No CAPTCHA elements found on pages. However, Cloudflare firewall blocks non-browser fetches at the network level (403), which is functionally similar to a CAPTCHA for automated agents.

4.3_bot_policy_or_agent_docs.details: No bot policy, no agent-specific documentation, no terms addressing automated access.

summary: XO Market scores poorly on agent accessibility (D grade, 6/15). The site is a Next.js app behind Cloudflare that blocks all non-browser requests. Key deficits: no llms.txt, no robots.txt, no sitemap.xml, no API/SDK documentation, and only placeholder docs ('Coming soon'). The domain now redirects via JS to alphaarcade.com (Alpha Arcade), suggesting a rebrand or acquisition. Strengths: good structured metadata (OG/Twitter/meta tags), clean URL slugs, proper 404 handling, standard link navigation, and docs link discoverable in nav.
